name: Alexei D'Orla
source:
The younger brother of a gang boss. He takes care of most of the grunt work and is notorious around town for his strength.

Outside of his job, he is easygoing, mischievous, and always down for a good time.

Likes: Cleanliness, a cold beer after a long day
Dislikes: People who don't listen

"Something I'm good at? Cleaning. Yeah, the regular kind. What's that look for? Wielding a map is basically the same as wielding a weapon, right?"

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048330/Mirage_Noir/]Steam[/url]]
